title: Manual check in the DAW: browse the clip folder, preview and drag clips onto the grid
description:
## Intent

Check in the DAW what a machine cannot: the folder browses well and the clips land on the grid.

## Steps (owner)

1. `apricity export --clips samples/marine-band -o ~/Music/Apricity-clips` (or from the library with `--library`).
2. Add the folder to the DAW's browser. Browse `Thunderer/loops`: names read well; preview plays each loop in time with the DAW's tempo.
3. Drag `A-1bar-...` and a section onto audio tracks: they start on the bar, stay on the grid for their length, and loops loop.
4. A sample with no beat grid (a speech or free-time recording): its clips play unwarped at their own speed.
5. Open a clip and read its info text: it names the sample and the saved clip.

## Verification

A comment with the DAW version and pass/fail per step; failures filed as bugs under this epic.

## Release

No commit.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI task.
